obernants.observation_scope: Values, shape, errors and named assertions
obernants.operator: Within validated arrays and candidate outputs, transform values unequal to the binary character sum and convolution values unequal to XOR-index sums are absent. Shape-invalid transform calls paired with mutation or Ok are absent. Finite oracle evidence is not a universal Rust proof.
obernants.assumptions: Prime field, declared resource domain and successful allocations

obernants.observation_scope: Values, shape, errors and named assertions
obernants.operator: For a fixed length, H and normalized inverse uniquely recover field residues, but raw u64 representatives are ambiguous modulo p. For convolution output c, retain every pair (a,b) on the declared padded domain with Ha*Hb=Hc; factoring is generally nonunique, especially when spectra contain zeros.

obernants.operator: Characters obey chi_k(i XOR j)=chi_k(i)chi_k(j), yielding H(a XOR-convolve b)=Ha*Hb. This diagonalizes XOR convolution specifically; ordinary index addition would require different characters and padding.
obernants.assumptions: Prime field, declared resource domain and successful allocations

obernants.operator: H²=nI on binary index domains; n=2^d is nonzero in an odd prime field. n^-1 exists by Fermat. No primitive roots or n dividing p-1 premise is needed. Matrix and inverse tests exercise these equations independently.
obernants.assumptions: Prime field, declared resource domain and successful allocations

obernants.observation_scope: Values, shape, errors and named assertions
obernants.operator: For nonempty inputs length is next_power_of_two(max lengths); indices i XOR j stay inside this domain. Trailing zeros remain in output. A singleton identity can thus increase the visible length of a non-power-of-two input. Empty operands map to empty only after length caps.
obernants.assumptions: Prime field, declared resource domain and successful allocations

obernants.observation_scope: Values, shape, errors and named assertions
obernants.operator: For equal padded domain, convolution is bilinear in residues and sum(c)=sum(a)*sum(b) modulo p. Neither property implies injectivity. Delta at index0 is the identity, while delta_i convolved with delta_i is delta0.
obernants.assumptions: Prime field, declared resource domain and successful allocations

obernants.observation_scope: Values, shape, errors and named assertions
obernants.operator: Transform checks nonzero power-of-two before cap, then normalizes. Convolution checks both caps before empty. Errors from validation leave transform input unchanged. Add/sub intermediates<2p and products<2^60 fit u64; bounded dimensions make doubling safe. Allocation refusal remains unforced.
obernants.assumptions: Prime field, declared resource domain and successful allocations
